verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Notte as a hosted SaaS platform (Bearer-token API, credits/pricing, cloud browser infrastructure) with a GitHub repo for its SDK/CLI, but there is no documentation, Docker setup, or infra guide for running the full browser-automation stack (proxies, captcha solving, vaults, etc.) on one's own servers. A community comment even asks whether an open-source alternative exists, implying self-hosting isn't clearly supported. Missing for 10: self-hosting/deployment docs, Docker or infra-as-code instructions, any first-party statement that the full platform can run outside Notte's cloud.
